title: Private Sunset BYOB Boat Ride on Southern Charm
includes: JBL Beach Bluetooth speaker $10. (Boat has a great sound system, the JBL is great to take to the beach) (not included)
Yeti Beach cooler and ice $20 (boat comes with a large cooler and ice but not removable to beach) (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy two hours cruising the harbor on a private center console captained by a professional yacht captain. Stop at secluded island beaches for shark tooth hunting, shelling or just enjoy the sunset while looking at mansions along the way. 
We pass by all the historic areas of the harbor and more. The perfect boat to see and do it all in style!
Southern Charm can reach speeds of 30mph, in two hours we can cover a lot of ground and visit many parts of the harbor. Get dropped off at Shem Creeks many restaurants is an option or have it catered through Caviar and Bananas.
We provide, cooler with ice, soft drinks, bottled water, Bluetooth boat stereo, Emergency porto potty, and Rain ponchos just in case
You may bring any food or beverages onboard.
